YOUR LEGAL PROCESS

Your Guide to Legal Convenience.

A simple process designed to help you understand what comes next, from your first inquiry to a clear legal plan.

Submit Inquiry

Complete the online inquiry form with the relevant details of your legal matter. Receive the screening link and instructions for the initial assessment.

Prepare & Upload

Gather case details and securely share relevant files and evidence.

Consult With Counsel

Discuss the matter, legal options, and relevant facts with the attorney.

Advice & Plan

Receive advice and a clear roadmap for the next steps.

PRIVACY FIRST

Your trust begins with how we protect what you share.

At HVC Law, privacy is more than a legal obligation—it is a fundamental part of responsible legal service.

We recognize that every inquiry, document, and legal matter may involve sensitive personal or business information.

We are committed to handling your information with transparency, legitimate purpose, and proportionality, consistent with the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (R.A. 10173).

Because choosing legal counsel means choosing someone you can trust with your information.

GET IN TOUCH

Let's discuss your legal concern.

Send an inquiry and provide enough context for the office to understand what you need.

Your inquiry is submitted securely for processing. A Zoom assessment schedule may be sent within 24 hours. The assessment is free of charge and is not the actual consultation.
